aros_history.DIARY: Matter called up and taken up in Board Mr. Asif, Court clerk of counsel for the Plaintiff is present and states that no record of evidence is available with them for re-constitution of the evidence file. He is directed to file a statement in this regard, staement to be filed in a weeks' time. Adjourned to 28-02-2024.

Matter called and taken up in Board. Mr. Hameed Hussain, Court Clerk of Mr. Ovais Hameed, Advocate is present. None present for the plaintiff. As per the Hon'ble Court's order dated 29.11.2023, learned counsel for the plaintiff was required to submit to this office any record available with him for the reconstitution of evidence file, however, notice issued to the learned counsel for the plaintiff for 17.01.2024, returned un-served as per bailiff report due to the relocation of his office. On the other hand, Mr. Hameed Hussain court clerk of Mr. Ovais Hameed, Advocate states that no record of evidence is available with them. He is directed to file a statement in this regard. Statement to be filed in two weeks' time. In the meanwhile, repeat notice to the learned counsel for the Plaintiff at the fresh address: Suite Nos. 412, 413 Paradise Chamber near Passport Office, Saddar, Karachi. Adjourned to 14.02.2024.

As per Court's order dated 24.08.2021 in S. No. 245 of 2003, further three months' time was granted to learned President High Court Bar Association to do the needful. For the time being captioned matter is adjourned to 22.09.2021.

Matter called and taken up in board. Order dated 04.03.2021 passed in Suit No. 245/2003 in which the Hon'ble Court was pleased to order that as informed due to severe illness of Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi Advocate/Commissioner he was unable to conclude the Commission and even despite making requests and appointing officials of this Court to make contact with him and to receive evidence part/file from him, no fruitful result had come out. Mr. Salahuddin Ahmed Advocate, President, High Court Bar Association was directed to take personal interest in the matter by making contact with Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi Advocate/Commissioner and subsequent order dated 29.03.2021 Mr. Salahuddin Ahmed Advocate, President High Court Bar Association stated that he made contact with Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi Advocate and requested him for return of evidence part/file; however, he informed him that he had no evidence file at his home and the same must be lying in his locker of High Court Bar Association. He has told him that he would locate the key of the locker; however, in case he failed to search out, he would depute a family member for breaking the lock of the locker and handover files to him. Mr. Salahuddin Ahmed Advocate requested for two weeks' time to do the needful. Time was granted. That Suit No. 1001/2005 is also mentioned in the list provided in Suit No. 245/2003 of pending cases lying before learned Commissioner. Suit No. 245/2003 is fixed in Court on 24-08-2021, for the time being captioned matter is adjourned to 08-09-2021.
Notice issued to the Ld. Commissioner Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi, Advocate returned served. No report has been filed by the Ld. Commissioner since 17.04.2017. Fix in Court for further orders.

As per Court's order dated 17.04.2017, Mr. Abdul Shakoor Advocate was appointed as a Commissioner and four months time was granted to conclude the evidence, which has expired on 16.08.2017, but the office was not fixed the matter last five months. Office is directed to be careful in future. Call report from the Ld. Commissioner. Adjourned to 21.02.2018.
